metadata.scenario: An automated robocall about extending the office's car warranty. The receptionist listens for a few seconds, realizes it's spam, and hangs up. Very short call.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I assist you today? Uh, hi, this is Charles Thompson. Hi, Charles! How can I help you? I just got a call about extending my car warranty? Oh, I think that might be a robocall. Let me listen for a moment. Yeah, it’s really odd. I just wanted to talk about my wound care. Sure, I understand. Let me just hang up on this call. *click* Sorry about that! Now, how can I assist you regarding your care? No problem! I had my last visit two days ago, and I wanted to check on my progress. Absolutely! I can provide you with the latest report from your nurse. Great! And can I request a male nurse for my next visit? Yes, I’ll make a note of that preference for you. Also, could you send a detailed report to the VA? Yes, we can do that. I’ll prepare it and send it over. Thanks! I’m still feeling some discomfort. I understand. Would you like to schedule a follow-up visit? Yes, I think that would be good. Let me get you scheduled. Would you prefer morning or afternoon? Afternoon would be best for me. Okay, I’ll check availability. One moment, please. *pause* We have an opening on Tuesday at 2 PM. Does that work? Yes, that works perfectly! Great! I’ll schedule that for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s all. Thank you! You’re welcome, Charles! We’ll see you on Tuesday. Sounds good, thanks again! Have a great day! You too, bye!
